info.title: Pay. Transaction Gateway Unit API
info.description: The restful API for interacting with the Pay. Transaction Gateway Unit.

post.description: Create an order on this TGU. An order represents the total order as it exists in your shop and can be fulfilled through one or more payments.

patch.description: Update an order with a reference and/or description. This action is only allowed for orders of the type 'payment_based_checkout' and only if the value to update is currently not set.
Abort an order, halting the regular order flow and voiding any payment attempts made to fulfill this order.
Accept an order with a lower amount than the original order amount.
Approve an order that is flagged for a risk check by the Verify module, continuing the regular order flow.
Capture an order that has an active reservation (Status 95). Reservations are commonly used for CreditCard and Buy now, Pay later payments. By using this API, the entire order will be captured.

Capture a specific amount on an order that has an active reservation (Status 95). Reservations are commonly used for CreditCard and Buy now, Pay later payments. With this API, you can capture a specific amount from the order while the reservation remains active.
Capture an order that has an active reservation (Status 95). Reservations are commonly used for CreditCard and Buy now, Pay later payments. By using this API, the entire order will be captured.
Decline an order that is flagged for a risk check by the Verify module, refunding all payments made on this order.

post.description: Append a new payment based on an existing pending order. When the summed amount of all completed payments reaches the order amount, the order will be completed.

patch.description: Retry an order that has a failed endstate by resetting the order status. Please note that the Order type will be changed to PAYLINK and the pointOfInteraction to ECOMMERCE. Also, any existing payments will not be removed.

get.description: Retrieve the current status of an order along with its corresponding payment attempts.

patch.description: Cancel an order with an active reservation (Status 95), voiding all payments made for that order as well.

201.description: Validated a pay per call pincode.

post.description: This endpoint initiates a pay per call transaction in the Transaction Gateway Unit API. It creates an order, starts the pay per call payment, and validates the payline number and pincode supplied by the payer.

200.description: Retrieved card details for a voucher

post.description:
This endpoint retrieves information about a voucher (gift card).

Use this API when you want to validate a voucher and check the amount, expiry date and brand information of the voucher.

This endpoint initiates a voucher (gift card) payment in the Transaction Gateway Unit API. It allows your system to process a payment using a voucher as the payment method in a direct request.

Use this API when you want to charge a voucher for an order amount and begin a payment transaction using voucher credentials (e.g., card number and PIN). This is part of the voucher & gift card payment flow, enabling you to handle voucher-based payments directly through your backend integration.
